'''Richard Rowan Rockingham Gill''' (born 1944) is a lecturer of philosophy, in particular logic, and is an author.

Gill received a [[Master of Arts|MA]] from the [[University of St Andrews]] and has published variously in the [[Association for Symbolic Logic|''Journal of Symbolic Logic'']], ''Archiv für mathematische Logik und Grundlagenforschung'' (Archive for Mathematical Logic and Basic Research) and other journals.

He lectured at the [[University of Wales, Lampeter]] and is also the former head of the Department of Philosophy.

==Publications==

===Articles===
* [https://www.jstor.org/stable/2270514?seq=1 ''The Craig-Lyndon Interpolation Theorem in 3-Valued Logic''], ''The Journal of Symbolic Logic'', Vol. 35, No. 2 (Jun. 1970), pp.&nbsp;230–238
* ''Soviet Oil in the 1980s: Shortage or Surplus?'', ''[[RUSI Journal|The RUSI Journal]]'', Vol. 121, No. 2 (Jun. 1976), pp.&nbsp;73–77
* ''On Wandschneider's Way Out'', ''[[Ratio (journal)|Ratio]]'', Vol. 19, No. 1 (1977), pp.&nbsp;85–87
* [https://www.jstor.org/stable/3328684 ''Frege on Infinite Axiom-Systems''], ''[[Analysis (journal)|Analysis]]'', Vol. 47, No. 3 (Jun. 1987), pp.&nbsp;173–175
* ''The Logic of Common Nouns'', ''Philosophical Books'', Vol. 23, No. 4 (Feb. 2009), pp 243–244

===Book reviews===
* [https://www.jstor.org/stable/2253795 ''Modern Logic—a survey. Historical, Philosophical, and Mathematical Aspects of Modern Logic and its Applications''. Edited by Evandro Agazzi], ''[[Mind (journal)|Mind]]'', New Series, Vol. 92, No. 366 (Apr. 1983), pp.&nbsp;286–288

===Books===
* ''Deducibility and Decidability'', Routledge: 1990 ({{ISBN|0-415-00033-5}})

*Visser, Albert, [https://www.jstor.org/stable/2275119 ''Deducibility and Decidability''. By R. R. Rockingham Gill.], ''The Journal of Symbolic Logic'', Vol. 58, No. 3 (Sep. 1993), pp.&nbsp;1080–1082
